parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables this {{object}} instance. This parameter is based on ''ifAdminStatus'' from {{bibref|RFC2863}}.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the option. When the value of this parameter is equal to "channel", the option value specifies the Communication Channel used for this scheduled task.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The value associated with the Option.

object.description: This object represents an option associated with the Scheduled Action. When an option with the same Name exists between the Seheduled Action's Option and The Task's option, the option of the Scheduled Action takes precedence over the option associated with the Task.
